reasons: Claimed status is 'compliant' and no redline or comment was proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding — the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs.

The cited text supports the conclusion: Section 11.2 provides only for termination on uncured material breach or insolvency with no pre-agreed damages sum, and 11.3 merely preserves accrued/ongoing payment obligations for Corio's then-existing Customers (a survival of fees, not a liquidated amount).
Exhibit B items cited (License Fees due on Acceptance; Implementation Fees on time-and-materials with a cap) are ordinary consideration, not penalties or minimum-fee-on-termination mechanics.

Correctly identifies Corio as our party (licensee/customer) and correctly declines to flag Vendor-side or Corio-favourable remedies (refunds, support commitments, revenue share) per the rule's detection guidance.
No deterministic check failures; rationale accurately notes the clause meets the preferred position rather than the fallback.
